info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Spruce Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Spruce Recliner Detail Submission API enables businesses to add detailed information about their spruce recliner products to the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the inclusion of critical specifications, features, and pricing for new recliner models. Retailers and manufacturers often utilize this API to ensure their product offerings are comprehensive and appealing to consumers. By leveraging this functionality, users can enhance their inventory data, improve product visibility, and drive sales.

post.summary: Create Details for a Spruce Recliner
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a specific spruce recliner. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating the details of a spruce recliner. The payload must include all necessary fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the details of the spruce recliner.

spruce_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the spruce recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the spruce recliner.

quantity.description: The number of spruce recliners requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the spruce recliner.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the spruce recliner.

CreateCatalogSpruceReclinerDetailRequest.description: Request body for operations related to the spruce recliner.

width.description: The width of the spruce recliner in specified units.

height.description: The height of the spruce recliner in specified units.

unit.description: The unit of measurement used for width and height (e.g., cm, inches).

Dimensions.description: Represents the physical dimensions of the spruce recliner.

CreateCatalogSpruceReclinerDetailRespons.description: Response schema for the POST operation concerning the details of a spruce recliner.

PricingDetails.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net amount for the pricing.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates if the tax is included in the net amount.

PricingDetails.description: Contains pricing information including net amount, currency, and tax inclusion.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response. Common values include 'application/json' or 'text/html'.

x-processing-time.description: Denotes the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This can help identify performance issues.
